label: rem:p4-universality-interpretation
title: $\alpha = 4/3$ recast as an intrinsic topological invariant
html:
Remark. \alpha = 4/3 recast as an intrinsic topological invariant

The critical exponent \alpha = 4/3 is framed as a universality-class invariant tied to the categorical structure of the QOU. It depends solely on representation-theoretic data and topology, decoupling the rate of blowup from specific PDE initial data.
